title: Agent configuration layering reference
summary: Explains what evidence an intermediate practitioner needs before determining which configuration layer takes precedence. It provides a safe investigation procedure when the applicable layering specification is unavailable.
prerequisites: Access to the configuration files or settings involved
Access to the authoritative documentation for the configuration system

sections.title: Which configuration layer wins?
paragraphs: UNKNOWN. The supplied material does not identify the applicable agent, configuration system, discovery locations, precedence order, merge behavior, or conflict-resolution rules. Do not infer that a nearby, user-level, project-level, or environment-provided value wins without an authoritative specification for the system in use.

This is an intermediate-level reference. Configuration can include values that vary between deployments, but that general definition does not establish how an unnamed system combines multiple sources. Determine precedence only from documentation that explicitly defines the applicable layers, their order, their scope, and whether values are merged or replaced.
sections.callout: If the applicable specification cannot be identified, report the precedence result as UNKNOWN rather than testing assumptions in a consequential environment.

sections.title: Correction status and safe procedure
paragraphs: The cited source associated with this update is content/resources/setup-quick-reference/agent-configuration-layering-reference.json. What changed is UNKNOWN because the supplied material does not establish whether that citation moved, merely passed its review cadence, or changed content. It also provides no previous HTTPS URL, replacement HTTPS URL, or source comparison. The affected substantive material is therefore UNKNOWN, so no tool-specific layering claim can be corrected responsibly.

Step 1: Obtain the exact existing resource and identify every claim and procedure tied to the cited source. If the file is unavailable, stop and request the repository version rather than reconstructing its wording or metadata.

Step 2: Identify the first-party specification for the configuration system and record both the previous and replacement HTTPS locations. If the system or replacement source cannot be identified, mark the correction blocked and request those details from the maintainer.

Step 3: Compare the previous and replacement source content for definitions of layers, scope, discovery, precedence, merge or replacement behavior, and conflict resolution. If either source cannot be retrieved, do not claim that its content is unchanged; record the comparison as UNKNOWN and retry with verified access or obtain an archived first-party copy.

Step 4: Change only statements and procedures affected by the documented source difference. If the comparison does not reveal which passages are affected, leave substantive guidance unchanged and escalate for editorial review instead of applying a speculative rewrite.

Step 5: Test each retained procedure against the documented observable result. If a step fails, use the identified system's first-party validation or diagnostic instructions. If no such instructions exist in the available documentation, stop and report that the remediation path is UNKNOWN.

sections.title: Expected evidence and verification
paragraphs: A verified correction requires the exact prior resource, an authoritative replacement HTTPS source, evidence of whether the source moved or changed, and a focused diff connecting each changed claim to the source difference. It also requires documented output or state showing that the stated precedence and procedure work for the identified configuration system.

Verify the result by confirming that the identifier and unaffected resource content match the prior file, every changed statement is supported by the replacement source, every fallible procedure step has a next action, all source URLs open directly over HTTPS, and the documented observable result is reproduced. With the supplied material, these checks are UNKNOWN and the correction remains blocked.
sections.callout: Do not mark the guide current until the replacement source and the unchanged portions of the prior resource have both been verified.
